notes.title: Nom Nom Apocalypse Unleashes on 13/02/20
notes.notes:
Happy to announce that NNA will be releasing 13th of Feb PST here on Steam. If you haven't seen the new trailer check it out now! 

To celebrate the announcement we're giving away a Nom Nom Apocalypse themed Wireless Xbox One controller prize box. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33047612/da44d2ca27bb49d9ee205af8924c30469a89194e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33047612/989a097001936a3ccf5cf8dee92ee7a391f59211.png[/img][/url]

All you have to do is enter the competition to be in the running: [url=https://gleam.io/qFU24/nom-nom-apocalypse-wireless-xbox-controller-giveaway]Nom Nom Apocalypse Wireless Xbox One Controller Giveaway[/url]. The competition is worldwide and only goes for a week so enter now!


We're also very proud to announce we're sponsors for GenerOzity's Australian Bushfire Relief charity Stream event which is happening today 6PM AEST and will be running for the next 48 hours. They'll be raffling two more NNA themed controllers there as well.  All proceeds go to charity! They're doing a great thing so tune in and donate please!
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/generozity]https://www.twitch.tv/generozity[/url]
[url=https://generozity.com.au/]https://generozity.com.au/[/url]


We also just wanted to thank you all for the support so far and are excited to launch very soon!


- Deadleaf Games

notes.title: Nom Nom Apocalypse In Beta
notes.notes:
We're happy to share that Nom Nom Apocalypse is on its way and in beta. While its taken longer than expected, we're taking time to make sure it's polished and packed with fun.

More exciting news is that it will be supporting Spanish(Spain), German, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Korean languages from launch! 

We're getting very close, so prepare for some big announcements early in the new year!
